remarks: Wonderful one bedroom unit in Sutton Place complex in sought after Wolfpit area. Walking friendly to shopping, restaurants and transportation. Great opportunity both for investors or first time homeowners. Features sunny living room, dining area, and one bedroom. Remodeled kitchen and bathroom is in the remodeling process with newly painted cabinets, new countertops, new flooring and tile backsplash. Remodeling should be finished approximately in 10 days. Heat, hot water and cooking gas is included in the common charges. wall to wall carpeting in Living room and bedroom. Complex has on site coin operated laundry. Wall unit air-conditioning.
